applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Quota supports conversion of eligible export-trade proceeds into CNY. It is separate from the cash received in the account.

| Route | How records reach the service |
|---|---|
| Store authorization | The supported platform connection retrieves eligible orders. |
| Platform export upload | Upload the platform's supported original export using its customized-format entry. |
| Generic template | Complete store details, download the CedarPay template, copy the required order data and submit it. |
| Linked RA collection | Eligible linked receipts generate quota without a second authorization or record upload. |

Platforms may support more than one route. Use the platform article and the store's operating model. Shopify Payments, PayPal, Backmarket, Salemonster, Mercado Libre and TEMU have platform-export arrangements; this list does not eliminate separately supported authorization routes.

Supported linked RA arrangements include AliExpress USD, Lazada cross-border and Achoice, Miravia, Asiabill and supported TikTok cross-border arrangements. AliExpress or Miravia receipts using a VA instead of the linked RA need the applicable manual records.

Import-marketplace proceeds cannot be justified by export-trade orders for this service. Examples include Tmall Global, JD International, PDD International, Suning's import service, Douyin import commerce and POIZON. Use foreign-currency withdrawal or transfer for those funds.
